scopeReview: IMP-7.A.1–3: resource depletion, consumption, pollution and climate in spatial/industrial development; ecotourism and community conservation; SDGs including finance and public transport assessed through multidimensional outcomes.
varietyReview: Four meaningful original stimuli: industrial recovered-input substitution, tourism receipt retention, development dashboard and visitor-route geometry. Other applications cover future needs, SDGs, lifecycle transfers and transition distribution.
repetitionReview: New stock-flow, local-retention and conservation-route tasks rather than number-only copies of urban intensity comparisons. Distinguishes renewability from sustainable use, nature marketing from ecotourism and project inputs from outcomes. Varied keys and all-option explanations; difficulty uncalibrated. Final review found the initial new aquifer balance too close to1.5; replaced this new item, preserving1.5 and its IDs. Revised case analyzes industrial material recovery rather than annual groundwater recharge.
referenceNote: Official curriculum and primary UN/UN Tourism definitions checked. All accounts, routes and examples are original hypothetical material; no real ecological clearance, safety/financial advice, outside lesson import or independent human review.
